nodes.name: Brotherhood of Silence
nodes.summary: Assassins-for-hire based primarily in Sarn, also called the Silent Brotherhood. The wiki says it acted as a hit squad for many of the Eternal Empire's elite (business with Cadiro and the Perandus family), framed Jorgin for his brother's death so he was exiled from Ogham, and surrounded Drusus in the Bath House until he drowned himself. Listed members: Shadow (former), Coralito and Vorici.

sources.locator: lead paragraph: 'faction of assassins-for-hire based primarily in Sarn'; section 'Lore': 'acted as a hit squad for many of the elite of the Eternal Empire' and the Jorgin and Drusus incidents. Era is not dated on the page (confidence low).

nodes.name: The Eldritch Decay
nodes.summary: Final Atlas quest given by Zana in the epilogue. The Exile spreads Elder influence to the four Tier 16 Shaper Guardian maps so the Elder spawns in the Shaper's Realm, then defeats the Elder Guardians and the Uber Elder. Removed from the game in 3.9.0 when the Atlas mechanic was reworked (introduced 3.2.0).

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Talk to Zana', completion 'Talk to Zana', act 'Epilogue'; section 'Walkthrough': 'Defeat the Elder (Uber Elder)'; Version history 3.9.0 'Removed from the game'

nodes.name: The Memory Eater
nodes.summary: Epilogue quest given by Zana. The Exile must collect 15 Memory Fragments by killing the bosses of Elder-influenced Atlas maps; each fragment can be exchanged for a Shaper's Orb, and each turn-in earns Zana reputation, and fragments II to X also earn a map of the same tier as the fragment. Removed in 3.9.0.

sources.locator: lead paragraph: 'a quest given by Zana in the story's epilogue ... collect 15 Memory Fragments by killing the bosses of 15 maps'; infobox start 'Speak to Zana'; Version history 3.9.0 'Removed from the game'

nodes.name: The Sacred Grove (quest)
nodes.summary: Introductory quest for the Harvest mechanic. After the Exile finds the Sacred Grove, Oshabi teaches the Exile to harvest the Grove's seeds (Wild, Vivid and Primal Lifeforce pools), kill the monsters that emerge, and talk to her about the harvest. Reworked in 3.13.0.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'The Sacred Grove', objective 'Talk to Oshabi about how to harvest the Grove's seeds', act 'Epilogue'; quest logs: 'Activate the Lifeforce Collector ... Kill the monsters that have emerged from the Seeds'; Version history 3.13.0 'Reworked'
section 'Quests': 'Oshabi offers players the following quest: The Sacred Grove'

nodes.name: The Ruler of Highgate
nodes.summary: Optional Act 9 quest. Kira has kidnapped Oyun to sacrifice her to Garukhan. The Exile kills Kira and Garukhan but cannot save Oyun; the Sekhema Feather is then given to Tasuni or Irasha (the Exile's choice), who rules Highgate. The reward is a Book of Skill.

sources.locator: lead: 'an optional quest in act 9'; walkthrough: 'Kira has kidnapped Oyun and plans to sacrifice her to Garukhan'; completion lines: 'You have given the Sekhema Feather to Tasuni and he now rules Highgate' / 'to Irasha and she now rules Highgate'; 'failed to save Oyun'

nodes.name: Recurring Nightmare
nodes.summary: Required Act 9 quest. Sin asks the Exile to gather Basilisk Acid and Trarthan Powder (Refinery, Boiling Lake) so he can burn a new entrance into the Beast. The Exile meets Sin at the Quarry, enters the Belly of the Beast, and kills the Depraved Trinity; Lilly Roth then offers to ferry the Exile to Oriath for Act 10.

sources.locator: walkthrough: 'Talk to Sin in Highgate about the Beast and what to do'; 'Meet Sin at the Quarry, where he will burn open a new entrance into the Belly of the Beast'; completion: 'You have killed the Depraved Trinity. Now talk to Lilly to gain access to Act 10'; Lilly Roth: 'Say the words and we'll set the sails.'

nodes.name: The Mother of Spiders
nodes.summary: Required Act 7 quest. After Silk's strange dialogue, Yeena sends the Exile to Arakaali's temple (Temple of Decay) to save Silk. The Exile kills Arakaali, which opens Act 8, but fails to save Silk.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Talk to Yeena', boss Arakaali, completion 'Go to Act 8'; walkthrough: 'Kill Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay to save Silk'; Quest Complete: 'You have killed Arakaali and gained access to Act 8, but failed to save Silk.'

nodes.name: The Father of War
nodes.summary: Required Act 6 quest. The Exile finds the missing Eye of Conquest (from the Dishonoured Queen), enters the Karui Fortress and Tukohama's Keep, and kills Tukohama, the Karui god of war. Sin then introduces the Pantheon. The quest completes when Tarkleigh rewards the Exile in Lioneye's Watch.

sources.locator: infobox: boss 'Tukohama, Karui God of War', key item 'Eye of Conquest', completion 'Talk to Tarkleigh after Tukohama is defeated'; walkthrough: 'After you defeat him, Sin will come and introduce the Pantheon'; Tarkleigh: 'You've killed the Karui war god?'

nodes.name: The Master of a Million Faces
nodes.summary: Required Act 7 quest. Eramir reads the Vaal inscriptions on the relic that washed ashore and identifies the god Ralakesh. Ralakesh has possessed Greust; killing Greust forces the god back into the relic, and destroying the relic may destroy the god. The route to the Old Fields runs through a secret passage from the Chamber of Sins, whose key Silk gives after Maligaro's map boss.

sources.locator: infobox: boss 'Ralakesh, Master of a Million Faces', start 'Talk to Eramir in the Bridge Encampment'; Eramir: 'Our poor friend, Greust, has likely become Ralakesh's avatar'; walkthrough: 'The key to this passage is given to you by Silk after you defeat Maligaro in the map device'

nodes.name: Queen of Despair
nodes.summary: Optional Act 7 quest. Sin sends the Exile into the Den of Despair in the Dread Thicket to kill Gruthkul, the Mother of Despair, whose children the Vaal slaughtered. Eramir rewards the Exile and records the story in a book.

sources.locator: infobox: boss 'Gruthkul, Mother of Despair', start 'Talk to Sin', completion 'Talk to Eramir', required 'no'; walkthrough: 'Into the most dreaded of thickets you must go ... Gruthkul the Despairing sulks and schemes'

nodes.name: The Silver Locket
nodes.summary: Optional Act 7 quest. Weylam Roth asks the Exile to find the Silver Locket, which holds a portrait of his late wife Meredith, buried in a lockbox near the Broken Bridge. Delivering it earns a reward; since 3.15.0 the reward is a choice of flask.

sources.locator: infobox: act 7, start 'Talk to Weylam Roth in the Bridge Encampment', required 'No'; walkthrough: 'buried near the Broken Bridge'; Weylam Roth: 'The box has a silver locket in it, holds the portrait of me late wife, Meredith'; Version history 3.15.0 flask choice

nodes.name: Breaking Down the Door
nodes.summary: Act 1 quest exclusive to the Betrayal league (historical). Jun asks the Exile to help dismantle Immortal Syndicate fortifications on the Coast and to defeat a Syndicate member there. It was replaced by The Immortal Syndicate after the league ended.

sources.locator: lead: 'was a quest in Act 1 exclusive to the Betrayal league. After the league end it is replaced by The Immortal Syndicate'; walkthrough: 'Jun wants you to help her find and dismantle the Immortal Syndicate fortifications on the Coast'

nodes.name: Dying for a Fight
nodes.summary: Optional tutorial quest for the Trial of the Ancestors (Ancestor league, historical). A Silver Coin opens a portal to the Halls of the Dead; Navali, a revenant, tells the Exile that they have apparently died and sends them into the Halls of the Dead, where winning a tournament completes the quest.

sources.locator: lead: 'an optional tutorial quest for Trial of the Ancestors'; walkthrough quote from Navali: 'Your coming was foretold, but you are decades early ... I am Navali, once a hatungo'; 'Quest Complete - You have won a tournament in the Halls of the Dead'

nodes.name: A Choice of Futures
nodes.summary: Tutorial quest for the Ultimatum mechanic (Ultimatum league). In a map, the Exile approaches an entity of Chaos, chooses one of the Trialmaster's challenges, completes the round without leaving the ritual circle, and decides whether to raise the difficulty or leave with the current reward.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Any map with Trialmaster', objective 'Start Ultimatum encounter'; walkthrough: 'Your path has led you to an entity of Chaos. Approach him.'; 'Complete the Trialmaster's (round number) challenge without leaving the ritual circle'

nodes.name: The Undertaker's Apprentice
nodes.summary: Tutorial quest for the Necropolis league mechanic. The Exile kills monsters until a usable corpse drops, buries it in The Necropolis, performs the exorcism by digging the grave, and returns to Undertaker Arimor to end the quest.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Approach Undertaker Arimor', objective 'Collect corpse / Perform the Exorcism in The Necropolis', completion 'Talk to Undertaker Arimor', act 1; walkthrough: 'Perform the Exorcism by digging the grave in the Necropolis'

nodes.name: Pound of Flesh
nodes.summary: Epilogue Metamorph-league quest. Tane Octavius asks the Exile to slay monsters and collect five different Metamorph organ samples; the samples summon a Metamorph which the Exile defeats. Afterwards Tane can be invited to the hideout and the Tane's Laboratory is accessible.

sources.locator: infobox: act 'Epilogue', start 'Map', objective 'Tane wants you to slay creatures and collect samples ... five different samples'; walkthrough: 'Your samples have summoned a Metamorph! Defeat it.'; 'the player character can access the Tane's Laboratory after the quest'

nodes.name: Safe and Sound
nodes.summary: Optional Act 2 quest. Helena asks the Exile to find a Hideout location rumoured in the Dread Thicket beyond the Vaal Ruins; after clearing it the Exile claims the Hideout and uses its crafting bench to enhance an item.

sources.locator: infobox: act 2, start 'Talk to Helena'; walkthrough: 'Helena wants you to find a suitable location for a Hideout. There is one rumoured to be located in the Dread Thicket beyond the Vaal Ruins'; 'Quest Complete - You have claimed a Hideout'

nodes.name: Prisoner of Fate
nodes.summary: Optional Act 1 quest (historical; the prophecy system was removed in 3.17.0). The Exile defeats the Faun in the Climb to free Navali, who thanks the Exile and teaches prophecies in Lioneye's Watch.

sources.locator: lead: 'Historical content ... the prophecy system was removed from the game in version 3.17.0'; walkthrough: 'Navali has been captured by the Faun in the Climb. Defeat the Faun to to rescue Navali'; Navali: 'Thank you for freeing me.'

nodes.name: The Redeemer (quest)
nodes.summary: Epilogue Atlas quest in which Zana's former colleague Veritania has gone insane and lurks in corner-region maps of the Atlas. The Exile finds her three times, then uses Kirac's information and Zana's portals to enter her Citadel and defeat Veritania the Redeemer. Reworked for 3.16 when the Atlas was reduced to four regions; removed in 3.17.

sources.locator: infobox: start 'Complete The Elderslayers', boss 'Veritania'; walkthrough: 'The third time you do, Veritania will appear and taunt the player'; 'talk to Kirac ... talk to Zana to open six portals into Veritania's Citadel'; Version history: reworked as regions reduced to 4; removed in 3.17

nodes.name: Strange Growths
nodes.summary: Blight tutorial quest (Act 3 or any Blight encounter). Sister Cassia asks the Exile to activate her Ichor Pump; the Exile builds towers near the Mycelium and defends the pump from Fungal Defenders. Completing it unlocks Anointing.

sources.locator: infobox: act 3, start 'Any Map (except Blighted Map) with the presence of Cassia'; walkthrough: 'Build a Tower near the Mycelium to help protect Cassia's pump'; 'Quest Complete - You have helped Cassia defend her Ichor Pump'; quest unlocks 'anointing'

nodes.name: Shattered Past
nodes.summary: Act 1 quest exclusive to the Synthesis league (historical; removed in 3.7.0). Cavas, an amnesiac, asks the Exile to explore and stabilise a corrupted memory and find more memories; once he remembers enough, the Exile is given access to the Memory Nexus.

sources.locator: lead: 'was a quest in Act 1 exclusive to the Synthesis league'; Cavas: 'Oh. Oh dear. Oh DEAR! I've remembered something! Exile, it is time we go to the Nexus.'; 'Quest Complete - You have gained access to the Memory Nexus'

nodes.name: Kitava's Heart
nodes.summary: A part of Kitava that spawns during its battle in Act 5 (Cathedral Rooftop, The Feeding Trough) and Act 10. Introduced as a boss monster in 3.0.0; since 3.2.0 it cannot be slowed below its base speed.

sources.locator: lead: 'Kitava's Heart is a part of Kitava that spawns during the battle with Kitava, the Insatiable, which occurs in Act 5 and Act 10'; Version history 3.0.0 'Introduced to the game as boss monster'; 3.2.0 speed note

nodes.name: Stridevolf
nodes.summary: Enclave on the southern outskirts of the Vastiri Plains, past Mount Vastiri. It was burned down by the unnamed 'bandit king of Stridevolf' during a conflict with the Maraketh warrior Orbala. Governor Kastov is listed among its notable members.

sources.locator: lead paragraph: 'an enclave on the southern outskirts of the Vastiri Plains, past Mount Vastiri ... burned down by the bandit king of Stridevolf during a conflict with Maraketh warrior Orbala'; 'Notable members: Governor Kastov'. No date is given on the page, so era is unknown.

nodes.name: Phaaryl
nodes.summary: Unexplorable location north of Sarn, said to be the point of invasion of the Harbingers as described in Commander Kirac's 'Kirac's Memory' quest dialogue. More than three thousand Oriathan soldiers were killed in the Battle of Phaaryl.

sources.locator: lead paragraph: 'an unexplorable location north of Sarn ... the point of invasion by the Harbingers, as described by Commander Kirac's Kirac's Memory quest dialogue. Over three thousand Oriathan soldiers were killed in the Battle of Phaaryl'

nodes.name: Veritania's Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable journal entries that appeared in Veritania's arena after she was defeated. They trace her from a self-described disciplined exile who is disgusted by Atlas vice, to the self-appointed 'Redeemer' who plans to purge the mortals who indulge.

sources.locator: section 'Journal I' to 'Journal IV': e.g. Journal III 'I am the only one that can save us', signed 'Veritania the Pure'; Journal IV 'I shall save you from your own vices by purging your weakness.' signed 'Veritania the Redeemer'

nodes.name: Sirus' Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable lore journals in the Conquerors of the Atlas boss rooms that expand the story of Sirus, Awakener of Worlds: his wish for purpose, his dread of the monster the group pursues, the last days with his companions, and his entrapment and 'empty' existence after he stepped into an orb of darkness.

sources.locator: section 'Journal 1' ('If it weren't for Zana...') to 'Journal 4' ('They left me. In my moment of need, they left me.' ... 'Empty.')

nodes.name: Drox's Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable journals in Drox's arena in which the former exile pursues a kingdom of law and justice through force, conquers valley after valley and grows more convinced that strength will make the mists real, ending as 'Drox the Warlord'.

sources.locator: section 'Journal I' ('Drox the Just') to 'Journal IV' ('Drox the Warlord.'); Journal I: 'I shall be the one who leads')

nodes.name: Baran's Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable journals from Baran's arena: a will bequeathing his staff and platemail to Veritania, Sirus, Drox and Al-Hezmin and his Oriathan home to Templar siblings; a letter to Landren about being trapped in the Atlas; a letter to a discoverer describing the demon that fed on Valdo Caeserius's memories ('the Decay') and Sirus's sacrifice; and a final entry in which Baran turns to God and plans to take the Atlas.

sources.locator: section 'Journal I' (Last Will and Testament: 'To my good friends and allies, Veritania, Sirus, Drox, and Al-Hezmin'), 'Journal III' ('feeding on the memories of Valdo Caeserius'), 'Journal IV' ('I am your sword')

nodes.name: Al-Hezmin's Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable hunter's journals from Al-Hezmin's arena. They are notes on his companions (Baran's prayers, Veritania's reading, Zana's secrets, Drox's drills), his rivalry with Drox, and a final entry about a 'New Person' who talked with Zana and seemed stronger than the other exiles.

sources.locator: section 'Journal I' (Baran: 'Prayer is the centre of his regimen'; Zana: 'Hiding something important') to 'Journal IV': 'New Person: I don't recognise this one ... Saw them talking to Zana.'

nodes.name: Victario's Writings
nodes.summary: Four environmental lore texts in The Library, written as anecdotes and allegory by the poet Victario of Sarn: Kalisa Maas and the Virtue gem that shatters glass; the Blackest Monkey parable; Slaves of Virtue, on shackled workers who mine gems for the Eternal citizens while Malachai abuses them; and A Friend in Need, on the musician Lorenzi who has a gem implanted in his hand.

sources.locator: section headings 'Volume 1: Kalisa Maas', 'Volume 2: The Blackest Monkey', 'Volume 3: Slaves of Virtue' (mentions Malachai and Highgate), 'Volume 4: A Friend in Need' (Lorenzi and Malachai's gem implant); each signed 'Victario of Sarn'

nodes.name: Aberrations
nodes.summary: Environmental lore objects tied to the Originator (Zana) and her father Valdo. Most entries are narrated by Zana: the Atlas as a trap, Sirus's transformation by the Atlas, her intervention through memory threads to save him, and the Templars' brutality. The entries in the Incarnation boss arenas are narrated by Valdo.

sources.locator: lead: 'environmental lore objects found in areas related to Zana, the Originator ... the ones in the Incarnation boss arenas are narrated by Valdo'; 'Entry 2 (The Success)': 'I set the threads in motion across time and space'; 'The Neglected Flame' on Sirus
